name: 爱尔兰一般就业许可
summary: 覆盖较广职业的爱尔兰就业许可，通常要求真实工作邀请、合资格职业、相应薪酬及劳动力市场测试。
summaryEn: A broad Irish work-permit route normally requiring a bona fide job offer, an eligible occupation, applicable remuneration and a labour-market test.

jobOffer.summary: 须有在爱尔兰真实经营并完成相应登记的雇主提供工作邀请。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A bona fide employer trading and appropriately registered in Ireland must provide the job offer.

occupation.summary: 职业不得在不合资格职业清单中，并须具备岗位所需资格、技能或经验。
occupation.summaryEn: The occupation must not be ineligible, and the applicant must have the qualifications, skills or experience required for the role.

labourMarket.summary: 通常须由雇主完成劳动力市场需求测试，官方列明的豁免除外。
labourMarket.summaryEn: The employer normally must complete a Labour Market Needs Test unless an official exemption applies.

sources.authority: Ireland Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment
sources.title: General Employment Permit

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
